subject: ylim() subsets data for display of boxplots

messages.author: 3b1b96295b24408a
messages.subject: ylim() subsets data for display of boxplots
parts:
In a situation where outliers are not wanted to show up in a boxplot,
ylim() is a handy shortcut to set the range of the y-axis. However, it
does not simply clip the figure but instead has the boxplots stats
calculated for the subset of data that fits into the desired range.
While boxplot_stats does display a warning ("Removed ... rows
containing missing values..." this same warning is triggered by true
NAs in the dataset. The messy user = me ;) - might then ignore the
warning with the NAs in mind, being unaware that boxplots are drawn
for a trimmed dataset.

A corresponding extension of the warning message could be helpful.

best regards
Ivo
